changelog:
- Initial release of ask-ai skill for automatic escalation to Doubao, Qianwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek AI when facing unsolvable problems.
- Implements a 6-step forced execution checklist, including sending questions, result validation, polling, self-checks, multi-turn clarification, and final evaluation.
- Features strict trigger and auto-escalation rules based on solution quality, confidence, and user input.
- Includes prioritized AI selection with automatic fallback on failure, and robust handling for login/captcha requirements.
- Provides a clear conversational template for querying external AIs and strict output requirements for every critical step.
- Saves all AI responses, ensures solution execution and closure, and documents every attempt and outcome for future review.
